attributes.action: To make using the likeness of any minor illegal in any pornographic content
attributes.additional_details: The sale of explicit content has rose dramatically with the creation of Onlyfans amongst more content creating websites for adult content. This has created a boom in creators going to dramatic levels to keep their fans, inventing abhorrent story lines to keep in the media to ensure content is bought. Recently, a creator has gone to disturbing levels to keep her sale's. This has involved the use of the likeness of a newborn baby. Any use of a minor in pornographic content should be made illegal.
attributes.background: To ban the use of any likeness of a minor in pornographic content. This extends from newborn all the way to the legal age of consent.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/781598
